reading_policy: Never pool, impute, or substitute other transcribers. Missing F is NOT_ESTIMABLE, not NO_MARKER.
look_definition: One R2 opener-class table is look6 in the original cap10. H result reused unchanged. Ending features not evaluated; no replacement suffix.

glyph_units.algorithm: Longest listed EVA group first; other lowercase EVA letters singly. No inferred phonetics or physical glyph identity.

ending_family_rule: First matching literal suffix in this fixed specificity order, else residual other; residual cannot be stripped or selected.
opener_rule: First matching literal prefix of the first word, else residual other. Other is reported but not a removable marker.
label_unit_rule: One fully readable numeric source locus per label. If the same numeric locator base has any alphabetic suffix, exclude all members of that base as unresolved multi-line/inserted-label grouping; do not guess physical consolidation. Multiword labels retain word boundaries, use first word for opener and final word for ending; reject the whole label if any slot is uncertain. No deletion of unknown slots.
paragraph_rule: Every readable word in source P units on these allowed pages; uncertain slots listed separately. Each word is one baseline item; no substitution for missing labels.
token_parser_rule: Preserve uncertain delimiters, braces and unknowns as exclusions; remove only EVT padding !,% and whitespace; confirmed .,-,= separators; comma marks adjacent slots uncertain. Only [a-z]+ slots admitted. Source terminal layout markers stripped without changing letters.

ring_policy: Source band IDs, not a new figure-to-locus registration. Keys=(folio,source unit). Distinct rings within zodiac section; S0 extra-top excluded from ring pair numerator/denominator. Geometry gaps and Leo uncertain figure not repaired; source label presence does not establish figure ownership.

primary_pair_formula.within: sum_r c_r(c_r-1) / sum_r n_r(n_r-1), ordered distinct label pairs
primary_pair_formula.different_ring_same_section: (C(C-1)-sum_r c_r(c_r-1))/(N(N-1)-sum_r n_r(n_r-1)), pooled open zodiac section
primary_pair_formula.other_labels: c_o(c_o-1)/(n_o(n_o-1)), pooled available star+plant-jar+rosette labels, same reading only
primary_pair_formula.ratio: within/other, undefined if other is zero or has fewer than2 valid labels; no smoothing or infinity-based candidate
primary_pair_formula.strata: Also report each comparator set, each zodiac panel/ring, extra-top, and paragraph shares in the same five planned tables.

selection.suffix: Largest defined ratio over ending-family and ending widths1–3, with at least one observed matching within-ring pair; other residual ineligible
selection.marker: Largest defined opener ratio among literal classes, with at least one observed matching within-ring pair
selection.ties: Descending exact rational ratio, then lexical value, then ascending width (family width0), then feature ID
selection.cross_reading: Same extraction/removal operation in H and F required. If either lacks zodiac labels or an adequate nonzodiac baseline, joint marker outcome NOT_ESTIMABLE. NO_MARKER only when both readings are estimable and neither candidate meets the rule.
selection.removal: Literal prefix/suffix deletion only for records classified by the selected feature. Any family-class conditioning must be explicit in a later C3 key; no stripping in C2.

qualification_scope: Descriptive C2 counts, not E1–E6 key scoring. Existing v7.2 qualification checked, but its tokenizer qualification is not claimed to validate physical EVA segmentation or this adapter.
limitations: No F zodiac rows in metadata; no H/F rosette-label rows.
